cat > /app/test_malformed.py << 'PYEOF'
import subprocess, json
lines=[]
def add(x):
    lines.append(x if isinstance(x,str) else json.dumps(x))
# valid compile empty fib
add({"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":32})
# invalid variants
add("")  # empty
add("{broken")
add("[]")
add("123")
add(json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[100,100,100,100]}))  # missing
add(json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":32,"x":1}))  # extra
add('{"op":"compile","op":"lookup","fib":[],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":32}')  # dup key
add(json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[100,100,100],"max_stride":32}))  # S=3
add(json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":0}))  # stride 0
add(json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[{"prefix":"::/0","hop":True}],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":32}))  # bool hop
add(json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[{"prefix":"::1/1","hop":5}],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":32}))  # host bits set
add(json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[{"prefix":"::/0","hop":5},{"prefix":"::/0","hop":6}],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":32}))  # dup normalized
add(json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[{"prefix":"::/00","hop":5}],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":32}))  # leading zero len
add(json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[{"prefix":"1.2.3.4/0","hop":5}],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":32}))  # ipv4
add('{"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[1.0,100,100,100],"max_stride":32}')  # float
add('{"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[NaN,100,100,100],"max_stride":32}')  # NaN
add(json.dumps({"op":"lookup","image":{"status":"infeasible"},"addresses":[]}))  # non-ok
add(json.dumps({"op":"lookup","image":None,"addresses":[]}))
# deep nesting
add("["*5000 + "]"*5000)
# many values
add("{"+",".join('"k%d":%d'%(i,i) for i in range(100000))+"}")
# valid after all
add({"op":"compile","fib":[{"prefix":"::/0","hop":7}],"capacities":[100,100,100,100],"max_stride":32})
data="\n".join(lines)+"\n"
r=subprocess.run(["/app/submit/run"],input=data.encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=60)
print("rc",r.returncode,"stderr",r.stderr[:200])
out=r.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print("nout",len(out),"nin",len(lines))
for i,o in enumerate(out):
    print(i,o[:100])
PYEOF
cd /app && python3 test_malformed.py
